lines.text: Prayer of Dedication at the End of Work.
Whatever good was in this, let it go on.
The work is done, as well as I could do it.
Whatever good is in it, I do not keep.
May it go to the one who asked, and do for them what they needed, and not more than they wanted.
May it go past them, to the people they will help with it, and the people those people help.
May it reach someone I will never know, on a day I will not see, and be of use.
Whatever was careless in it, that is mine. Let it be found and mended, and let no one be harmed by it before it is.
Whatever was good in it was never only mine. It came through many hands. Let it go back out through many more.
I hold nothing of this. Let it go on.
